early_snapshot.scope: Early development snapshot, before final combat/camera/cloth/audio fixes
early_snapshot.limits: Headless real-time stress fixture with health/stamina refills and forced rematches. Actions are requests, not all completed attacks. Minute-sampled Godot static memory is not process/GPU memory. Not natural play, rendered quality or frame-rate acceptance.

final_candidate.scope: Final runtime used in the d6eb9e7 Windows delivery package
final_candidate.limits: Headless real-time stress fixture with health/stamina refills and forced rematches. Actions are requests, not all completed attacks. Minute-sampled Godot static memory is not process/GPU memory. Not natural play, rendered quality or frame-rate acceptance.

scope_note: The three-hour run is an early snapshot. The final runtime received a separate 90-minute run; do not add the durations and attribute them to one candidate. Intermediate stopped runs are excluded.
